\caption{Functa against the fine-tuned few-shot baseline (FS-FT) when both see the same $N$ points. For each constraint, $N$ points are drawn from the unconstrained GMM target. Functa labels all of them with $\tanh P(x)$ and extracts its latent from them with the frozen SIREN; FS-FT fine-tunes the base unconditional flow matcher on the $N_{\mathrm{in}}$ of them that satisfy $P(x) \le 0$ (median shown). Smaller budgets are prefixes of larger ones. Values are medians over the 917 of 1000 validation constraints with at least 5 inside points at $N{=}50$. The SIREN was meta-trained on uniformly distributed query points. FS-FT early-stops against 10{,}000 held-out constraint-satisfying points, which makes it an optimistic upper bound.}
